{{Quote|Step forward, Padawan. Anakin Skywalker, by the right of the Council, by the will of the Force, dub thee I do, Jedi Knight of the Republic.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], during [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|knighting]] ceremony|<ref name="CW21">{{CW|21}}</ref>}}
The '''Hall of Knighthood''' was a ceremonial chamber located directly below the [[Pinnacle Room/Legends|pinnacle room]] of the [[Temple Spire/Legends|Temple Spire]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. It was in this chamber that members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] would formally be granted a new rank on the path of being a Jedi.

==History==
[[File:Knighting.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The knighting of [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and ascension of [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] to Jedi Master.]]

The Hall of Knighthood was located within the flared section at the summit of the tower. Over the history of the Jedi Order, [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|initiates]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] would be formally recognized as having acquired a higher rank in the Order.<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> While it was the ceremonial place of ascension, the [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|Knighting ceremony]] occasionally took place elsewhere due to extragent circumstances.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

It was custom for Jedi about to ascend in rank to spend the night in meditation in the private chambers below the hall. Following the night of rest, the Jedi would enter the Hall of Knighthood and a gathering of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], typically made up of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], would raise the rank of the individual.<ref name="CW21" />

During the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] several of the last generation of Jedi were knighted here. In [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] Padawan [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] was made a Knight, while her master [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] became a full Jedi Master.<ref name="RoP" /> Additionally, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] would be knighted by the Council at some point early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CW21" /> Notably, Jedi High Council member [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was not knighted here; instead he was raised to the rank of Knight by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="TPM" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] the elusive [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], in his persona as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], ordered the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to execute [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]]. Led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] marched through the Temple and slaughtered all its occupants. [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]] gunships flew low over the Temple Ziggurat and shattered the base of Tranquillity Spire, causing it to list.<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

==Layout==
Located below the [[Pinnacle Room/Legends|pinnacle room]] and above a private meditation chamber,<ref name="SWCL" /> the Hall of Knighthood was an open room with tall windows and several pillars.<ref name="RoP" /> The circular pattern in the center of the chamber was reminiscent of the pattern used in the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|High Council Chamber]] at the summit of the [[High Council Tower/Legends|Tower Spire]].<ref name="CW21" /> Accessed by a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] and a staircase that spirals up from the lower levels, the chamber allowed those inside to have one of the highest and rarest views of the area surrounding the Temple.<ref name="SWCL" />

Using no artificial lighting, the chamber would be filled with sunlight during daytime ceremonies,<ref name="RoP" /> and the glow of the planet at night. The Masters participating in the ceremony would encircle a kneeling Jedi, ignite their lightsabers, and one would proceed to sever the Padawan braid from the new Knight's head.<ref name="CW21" />
